next_research_campaign.status: MIXED_PAIR_LIFT_CLOSED; CAYLEY_ORDER45_CLOSED; AUTOMORPHISM_GROUP_IS_A_2_GROUP_FOR_RAMSEY_SRG: levels 1 and 2 of the exact local identity basis are exhausted; all 8,388,608 order-45 Cayley connection sets are excluded; and every odd-prime automorphism is excluded for a Ramsey-good srg(45,22,10,11). Order three is the prior solver-free closure. For order five, a Ramsey-free orbit-diagonal moment eliminates f>=10, a 56,755-prefix integral Seidel-quotient search eliminates f=0 in the Ramsey lane, and an R(3,4)/R(4,3) incidence bridge eliminates f=5. Orders seven and eleven fall to support/complement packing, a fixed-block Rayleigh contradiction, and a complete 46,200-block cyclic enumeration. Orders at least thirteen fall by handshake or cycle parity. Cauchy's theorem therefore makes the automorphism group a 2-group; involutions remain open. Published replay independently verifies all 288 Maksimovic S3 graphs and finds both K5 and I5 in each. No R(5,5) bound is claimed. Residual routes: involution symmetry, VeriPB-certified non-local gluing, or asymmetric complementary SAT.
next_research_campaign.claim_class: Publishable structural lemma or exact reduction for hypothetical Ramsey(5,5,45) graphs; not a benchmark speedup and not an R(5,5) bound unless complete coverage is separately proved.
next_research_campaign.problem: The implemented structural layer uses only the m=2 McKay-Radziszowski excess identity, whose n=45 edge-deficiency ceiling is 360. Candidate 3 showed that one-vertex edge-window filtering removes cheap pairs rather than dominant search mass.

first_exact_basis.features: Exact induced-subgraph counts for the connected and T_{m,j} patterns required by those identities, with complement counterparts; no floating-point motif counts.
first_exact_basis.domains: All 656 validated Ramsey(5,5,42) graphs; every applicable validated R(4,5) edge-extremal catalog at orders 17-24; the complete validated order-24 catalog where required.

architecture.deliverable: An independent combinatorial derivation and exact-integer verifier for m=3 first, followed by m=4 and the mixed identity only if m=3 passes.
Deterministic exact feature vectors with SHA-pinned inputs and independently recomputed aggregate checks.
A rational LP/ILP over degree, edge-deficiency, motif, complement, and handshake constraints. Optimization output may propose a cut but is outside the trust base.
Explicit rational coefficients, complete hypotheses, a human-readable counting proof, and a disjoint checker proving the finite catalog inequalities used by the cut.

significant_success_gate.required: A universally proved n=45 consequence with a primary-source novelty audit and independent replay.
quantified_consequences_any_one: Eliminate degree 20 from every hypothetical Ramsey(5,5,45) graph.
Lower a required edge-deficiency layer from 8 to 7, eliminating the deepest catalog layer.
Reduce the global deficiency ceiling from 360 to at most 315.
Eliminate an entire named positive-deficiency local-type family required by every complete gluing cover.
not_sufficient: A numerical LP optimum without an exact certificate.
An identity already in the primary sources without a new n=45 consequence.

trust_model: AI and optimization solvers remain outside the trust base.
Every identity is derived independently and evaluated in exact integer or rational arithmetic.
Known identities must replay on all 656 validated n=42 graphs and every applicable validated extremal catalog.
The final cut must have explicit rational coefficients and a separate checker.
Catalog completeness assumptions are named; a bound claim requires a separate complete certificate chain.
Novelty is checked against the primary sources before any result is called new.
stop_conditions: Stop and record a negative result if m=3 fails exact replay.
Stop this basis and record a negative result if m=2,3,4 plus the mixed identity produce no strict accepted consequence after all predefined feature vectors are exhausted.
Do not pivot to search-engine optimization, SDP, or raw catalog scaling without a separately approved design.
